app.name: Robot For All
app.description: Free robotics and STEM lessons for learners, teachers and parents. Build robots from cardboard, then learn to code them.
nav.label: Main
home.intro: Build a real robot from cardboard, sticks and one small motor. Then learn to control it with code.
home.point_offline: Works on basic phones, even offline
home.coming_soon: The first lessons are on their way.
about.title: About Robot For All
about.mission: Robot For All makes robotics and STEM education free for every child and adult, whatever their income, language or school.
about.how_build: Build: make moving robots from cardboard using cranks, gears, levers and linkages, linked to the school syllabus.
about.how_control: Control: add a micro:bit or similar board to make your robot move, stop and light up.
about.how_integrate: Integrate: design complete robot projects that combine everything you have learned.
about.who_body: Learners from Grade 3 upward, teachers, robotics coaches, parents, homeschool families, schools and community centres.
footer.promise: No ads. No tracking. Free for everyone.
